questions.question: What does Daniel 11 describe in detail?
options: The conflicts of the kings of the North and the South
The long reign of the kings of the royal house of David
The full rebuilding of the holy temple in Jerusalem
The return of all the exiles from the land of Babylon
questions.answer: The conflicts of the kings of the North and the South

questions.question: How are those who know their God described in Daniel 11?
options: They shall be carried away into exile
They shall flee and abandon the faith
They shall grow rich and powerful
They shall stand firm and take action
questions.answer: They shall stand firm and take action

questions.question: Daniel 11 foretells a contemptible king who exalts himself and a time of great conflict.
The people who know their God will firmly _____ him.
Those with insight will _____ many, though for a time they fall.
